product_from_film: Simi turns a written question into a drawn visual explanation.

product_clear_basis: The question entered at 34s is paired with a gravitational time dilation diagram at 44s, making the input/output relation visible.

categories.finding: Visible captions and the retained question make the input/output story readable silently. Full educational value is difficult to judge from the short output view.
The prompt and configuration menus are enlarged; the output is smaller beside the retained question before examples fill a grid.
Nearly half the film builds the historical/problem argument, while the main output example receives about 4s.
The drawing-history premise pays off in generated-looking diagram cards, though the teaching sequence is only briefly sampled.
Familiar science imagery may lend authority and the office montage may create recognition; viewer response is unmeasured.
The exact black-hole question stays above its related diagrams, making the causal connection stronger than an unrelated output montage.
The film shows an illustrative output and broad claims; factual correctness, learning outcomes, language support and generation reliability were not independently checked.
The iris-like Simi mark and drawing-based premise provide an identity; a longer single explanation could make the output quality more distinctive.
Give one diagram enough time to complete and teach one specific point.
